source: Original fictional demo content created for ExamSprint

notes.title: Meet SproutBot
paragraphs: Pattern Orchard is an imaginary greenhouse where SproutBot sorts glowing plants. Each training card contains a plant's features and a label chosen by the gardeners.
SproutBot studies the labeled examples, then predicts a label for new plants. It does not understand gardening; it follows patterns in the examples.
bullets: Features: visible clues such as gold leaves and blue dots
Label: the result written by a gardener
Prediction: SproutBot's result for a new plant

notes.title: The fictional glow score
paragraphs: In this demo, glow score = two points for each gold leaf plus one point for each blue dot.
A score of 7 or more means Harvest. A score from 4 to 6 means Observe. A score of 3 or less means Water. These rules exist only inside Pattern Orchard.

notes.title: Check before release
paragraphs: Gardeners keep some labeled plants in a separate check garden. SproutBot does not see them while learning. Afterwards, the gardeners compare its predictions with the hidden labels.
They also compare results from the sunny and shaded zones. A large difference is a reason to inspect the examples and collect better data before using the robot.

questions.text: In Pattern Orchard, what is a feature?
options: A visible clue about a plant
questions.explanation: Features are the clues SproutBot receives, such as gold leaves and blue dots.
questions.explanationNo: En feature er et kjennetegn roboten får, som gullblader eller blå prikker.

questions.text: Who provides the labels on the training cards?
questions.explanation: The fictional gardeners label the examples used for training.
questions.explanationNo: De oppdiktede gartnerne merker eksemplene som brukes til trening.

questions.text: What does SproutBot produce for a new plant?
options: A training card from the past
questions.explanation: SproutBot uses learned patterns to predict a label.
questions.explanationNo: SproutBot bruker mønstre til å forutsi en merkelapp.

questions.explanation: The fictional rule assigns Harvest to scores of 7 or more.
questions.explanationNo: I demoreglene betyr 7 poeng eller mer Harvest.

questions.text: Why are some plants kept in a separate check garden?
options: To test SproutBot on unseen examples
To hide all gold leaves forever
questions.explanation: The separate plants test how the robot performs on examples it did not study.
questions.explanationNo: Den separate hagen tester roboten på eksempler den ikke har sett under trening.

questions.text: A plant has 2 gold leaves and 1 blue dot. What is its glow score?
questions.explanation: Two gold leaves give 4 points and one blue dot gives 1, for a total of 5.
questions.explanationNo: To gullblader gir 4 poeng, og én blå prikk gir 1. Totalt blir det 5.

questions.text: A plant has 3 gold leaves and 2 blue dots. Which label does it receive?
questions.explanation: The score is 3 × 2 + 2 = 8, which is Harvest.
questions.explanationNo: Poengsummen er 3 × 2 + 2 = 8, og det gir Harvest.

questions.text: A plant has 1 gold leaf and 2 blue dots. Which label does it receive?
questions.explanation: The score is 2 + 2 = 4, which falls in the Observe range.
questions.explanationNo: Poengsummen er 2 + 2 = 4, som ligger i Observe-området.

questions.text: SproutBot scores well on training cards but poorly in the check garden. What is the best next step?
questions.explanation: Poor performance on unseen examples is a reason to inspect the training process and data.
questions.explanationNo: Dårlige resultater på nye eksempler betyr at treningen og dataene bør undersøkes.

questions.text: Why compare results from sunny and shaded zones?
options: To change the score formula automatically
questions.explanation: The gardeners compare zones to spot uneven performance that needs investigation.
questions.explanationNo: Gartnerne sammenligner sonene for å oppdage ujevne resultater som bør undersøkes.

questions.text: Plant A has 2 gold leaves and 3 blue dots. Plant B has 3 gold leaves and no blue dots. Which statement is correct?
options: A is Harvest and B is Observe
A is Observe and B is Water
questions.explanation: A scores 7 and is Harvest. B scores 6 and is Observe.
questions.explanationNo: A får 7 og blir Harvest. B får 6 og blir Observe.

questions.text: What is the smallest number of blue dots needed for a plant with 2 gold leaves to become Harvest?
questions.explanation: Two gold leaves give 4 points. Three blue dots raise the score to 7.
questions.explanationNo: To gullblader gir 4 poeng. Tre blå prikker øker summen til 7.

questions.text: The sunny zone is predicted correctly 18 of 20 times, while the shaded zone is correct 10 of 20 times. What should the gardeners do?
options: Inspect the difference and collect better examples
Give every plant the Harvest label
questions.explanation: The large gap between zones signals that the examples or model behavior need investigation.
questions.explanationNo: Den store forskjellen mellom sonene betyr at eksemplene eller modellen bør undersøkes.

questions.text: A mislabeled training card says Water for a plant scoring 8. Why can this matter?
options: SproutBot may learn a misleading pattern
questions.explanation: Training labels guide the pattern learned by SproutBot, so a wrong label can mislead it.
questions.explanationNo: Merkelappene styrer mønsteret SproutBot lærer, så feil merking kan villede roboten.

questions.text: A plant has 1 gold leaf. How many blue dots would move it from Water directly to Harvest?
questions.explanation: One gold leaf gives 2 points. Five blue dots make the total 7, which is Harvest.
questions.explanationNo: Ett gullblad gir 2 poeng. Fem blå prikker gir totalt 7, som betyr Harvest.
